newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (3 OF 7).
newsitem.headline: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (3 OF 7).

text.p: (This is an unofficial translation of Romania's government Decree no.31/16.06.1997 on foreign investment. The unofficial translation was provided by Price Waterhouse Romania.
For any querries please contact Price Waterhouse at telephone +40-1 311-2455, fax +40-1 312-3334.)
CHAPTER THREE (of seven)
Legal Status of Foreign Investments Made by the Purchase of Shares Administered by the State Ownership Fund in Companies which Become Private

Art.9 (1) Incentives shall be granted to foreign investments which are based upon share sale and purchase contracts concluded with the State Ownership Fund for a minimum amount of USD 1,000,000 or the equivalent thereof in any other freely convertible currency and/or in lei, if the foreign investor undertakes to satisfy the following conditions:

a. Ensure, as a post-privatization effect, the restructuring, modernisation and turning around of the company the shares of which were subject to the share sale and purchase contract made with the State Ownership Fund, including the reduction of specific material and energy consumption;
b. Ensure the labour safety by using new technologies and training human resources;

c. Contribute to the economic development and increase of the employment rate in the area of operation of the company the shares of which were subject to the share sale and purchase contract made with the State Ownership Fund;

d. Ensure the integration of its production in Romania in a proportion of at least 30 percent, which proportion is established in accordance with the share held by the raw and auxuliary materials, parts and subassembles manufactured in Romania in the total costs of the finished products;
e. Export of at least 40 percent of the value of their annual output;
f. Invest in environmental protection.

(2) The amount of USD 1,000,000 or its equivalent in any other freely convertible currency and/or in lei, provided for in paragraph (1) refers exclusively to the price paid by the foreign investor for the package of the shares purchased from the State Ownership Fund by any of the methods permitted by the law.
Art.10 (1) Companies complying with the provisions of Article 9 hereinabove shall benefit from the following facilities.
a. Payment of a 15 percent tax applicable to profits obtained, for a period of 5 years from the date of execution of the share sale and purchase contract;

b. Exemption from the payment of customs duties and value added tax applicable to equipment, machines, outfits and installations necessary for the modernisation of the production or protection of the environment, for a period of 8 years from the date of execution of the share sale and purchase contact, and a 50 percent reduction thereof fro an additional period of 2 years, for the same class of products;

c. Exemption from the payment of customs duties and any other taxes related to the transfer of know-how made by the foreign investor for the purpose of enhancing the technical, technological, commercial or financial performances of the company the shares of which were subject to the share sale and purchase contract made with the State Ownership Fund;

d. The 50 percent reduction of the customs duties for a four years period from the date of concluding the contract of buying-selling shares with the State Ownership Fund, for raw materials, materials for production, consumables, spare parts and/or imported components necessary to carry out the own production, whose equivalent value is paid from their own sources, attracted or borrowed from abroad.

e. Making available the percentage provided by Article 8 of Law No55 of 1995, regarding the acceleration of the privatisation process, to the privatised company, in the freely convertible currency in which the shares were paid.

(2) the incentives provided in paragraph (1) shall be granted subject to the satisfaction of the classification criteria defined in the respective paragraph, assumed as obligations on the account of the purchaser under the share sale and purchase contract made with the State Ownership Fund, and shall be applicable as of the date of full payment of the purchase shares.
-- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
